name: Ohiullah
contribution: The nine-year-old boy was killed in the violence connected to the 1952 protests.
context: Dhaka during the escalation after the police firing.
impact: His death made the brutality of state repression impossible to describe as a narrow campus incident.
highlight: Ohiullah, a nine-year-old child, was among the civilians killed in the violence surrounding Dhaka's 1952 language protests.
seoTitle: Ohiullah: Child Victim of the 1952 Language Movement
seoDescription: Remember Ohiullah's place in the civilian toll and public memory of the police firing during Dhaka's 1952 Language Movement.
shortAnswer: Ohiullah was a nine-year-old child killed amid the police firing and violence connected to Dhaka's 1952 Language Movement protests.
